# Thirupathy Bright Industries (Thirupathy Bright Industries)

> Manufacturer of bright and black steel bars in round, square, hexagon and flat profiles, with integrated cold drawing, peeling, centreless grinding, finishing and in-house testing. Operating since 1996. Certified IATF 16949, ISO 14001:2015 and MSME ZED Silver.

Plant: Survey No. 37 & 38, Thadalacherry Village, Gummidipoondi Estate, Thiruvallur Dist., Tamil Nadu 601201, India.
Careers: hr@thirupathybright.com

## Facts
- Manufacturer: Thirupathy Bright Industries, Gummidipoondi, Thiruvallur District, Tamil Nadu, India. Established 1996.
- Certifications: IATF 16949, ISO 14001:2015, MSME ZED Silver.
- Bright (cold drawn) sizes: rounds 3-101.6 mm, squares 4.75-78.5 mm, hexagons 8-100 mm AF, flats 12x5 to 150x50 mm (W x T).
- Black (hot rolled) sizes: rounds 5.5-200 mm, squares 10-250 mm, flats 20x6 to 350x80 mm (W x T). Profiles as per customer drawing.
- Other grades and sizes can be supplied subject to MOQ and raw material availability.
- Supply regions: Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Telangana (including Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Coimbatore, Hosur and other cities).
- Minimum sizes: bright rounds 3 mm, squares 4.75 mm, hexagons 8 mm AF, flats 12x5 mm; black rounds 5.5 mm, squares 10 mm, flats 20x6 mm.
- Sales / enquiries: +91 4344 278 000, https://thirupathybright.com/contact.html
- Marketing team: Mr. S. Srikanth +91 98400 89608 (srikanth@thirupathybright.com); Mr. Ranjith +91 98400 89603 (ranjithsspchi@gmail.com); Mr. Dheeraj Pal +91 98400 89855 (dheeraj@thirupathybright.com); Mr. Arockiaraj +91 9870213374 (susai7raj@gmail.com).

## Pricing and buying
- Price depends on grade, size, profile, finish, order quantity and raw material cost, so it is quoted per enquiry: +91 4344 278 000 or https://thirupathybright.com/contact.html
- Manufacturer-direct supply from an integrated works (cold drawing, peeling, centreless grinding, finishing and testing in-house). Bulk and custom orders are quoted on request.

## Steel grade categories
Mild Steel, Medium Carbon Steel, Spring Steel, Carbon Manganese Steel, Chrome Manganese Steel, Free Cutting Steel. Grades are cross-referenced across IS, EN, DIN, AISI/SAE and JIS, each with chemical composition.
